question:
"Jul 28 2023  3:16PM"
"Jul 29 2023  3:10PM"
"2022-09-29 11:30:00"
"Nov 20 2022  6:54PM"
"2022-11-26 20:30:00"

Have multiple date formats like this and i want to bring all of them in one standard format without explicitly specifying format

SELECT 
    TRY_CAST(your_date_column AS DATETIME) AS standardized_date
FROM 
    your_table;
But for the "Jul 28 2023  3:16PM" is shows null
title: I have a date column which have values like this "Jul 28 2023 3:16PM" "2022-09-29 11:30:00" and i want to bring them in one format in sql
answer:
Here is a working example of what you could do using Snowflake SQL:

with my_values as (
    select 'Jul 28 2023 3:16PM' as my_date
    union all
    select '2022-09-29 11:30:00'
    union all
    select 'Nov 20 2022 6:54AM'
)

select
    coalesce(
        try_to_timestamp(my_date, 'MON DD YYYY HH12:MIPM'),
        try_to_timestamp(my_date)
    )
from my_values;

Which returns:

2023-07-28 15:16:00.000
2022-09-29 11:30:00.000
2022-11-20 06:54:00.000
